using namespace std;

#define INF 1000000000
#define MOD 1000000007
#define EPS 1e-9
#define PI 3.14159265358979323846264338327950288
#define pb push_back
#define mp make_pair

struct Node {
    Node* left;
    Node* right;
    int batchSetValue;
    bool dirty;
    int min;

    Node() {
        left = NULL;
        right = NULL;
        batchSetValue = 0;
        dirty = false;
        min = INF;
    }

    void pushUp() {
        this->min = min(left->min, right->min);
    }

    void setValue(int val) {
        this->min = val;
        this->batchSetValue = val;
        this->dirty = true;
    }

    void pushDown() {
        if (dirty) {
            left->setValue(batchSetValue);
            right->setValue(batchSetValue);
            dirty = false;
        }
    }

    void update(int i, int l, int r, int val) {
        if (i > r || i < l) {
            return;
        }
        if (i <= l && i >= r) {
            setValue(val);
            return;
        }

        pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        update(i, l, m, val);
        update(i, m + 1, r, val);

        pushUp();
    }

    int query(int f, int t, int l, int r) {
        if (f > r || t < l) {
            return INF;
        }
        if (f <= l && r <= t) {
            return min;
        }
        pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        return min(query(f, t, l, m), query(f, t, m + 1, r));
    }

    void toArray(int l, int r, int* data) {
        if (l == r) {
            data[l] = min;
            return;
        }
        pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        toArray(l, m, data);
        toArray(m + 1, r, data);
    }

    void fromArray(int l, int r, int* data) {
        if (l == r) {
            min = data[l];
            return;
        }

        dirty = false;
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        fromArray(l, m, data);
        fromArray(m + 1, r, data);
        pushUp();
    }

    string toString() {
        int t = 100;
        int* data = new int[t + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
            data[i] = query(i, i, 0, t);
        }
        string ret = "";
        for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
            ret += to_string(data[i]) + " ";
        }
        delete[] data;
        return ret;
    }
};

class BlockReader {
    static const int EOF = -1;
    int dPos, dSize, next;
    char* dBuf;
    ifstream is;

    BlockReader() {}

public:
    BlockReader(const char* filename) {
        is.open(filename);
        dBuf = new char[4096];
        next = nextByte();
    }

    BlockReader() {
        dBuf = new char[4096];
        next = nextByte();
    }

    ~BlockReader() {
        delete[] dBuf;
    }

    int nextByte() {
        while (dPos >= dSize) {
            if (dSize == -1) {
                return EOF;
            }
            dPos = 0;
            is.read(dBuf, 4096);
            dSize = is.gcount();
        }
        return dBuf[dPos++];
    }

    string nextBlock() {
        string ret;
        while (next != EOF && next != ' ' && next != '\n') {
            ret += (char) next;
            next = nextByte();
        }
        return ret;
    }

    void skipBlank() {
        while (next != EOF && (next == ' ' || next == '\n')) {
            next = nextByte();
        }
    }

    int nextInteger() {
        skipBlank();
        int ret = 0;
        bool rev = false;
        if (next == '+' || next == '-') {
            rev = next == '-';
            next = nextByte();
        }
        while (next >= '0' && next <= '9') {
            ret = (ret << 3) + (ret << 1) + next - '0';
            next = nextByte();
        }
        return rev ? -ret : ret;
    }

    int nextBlock(char* data, int offset) {
        skipBlank();
        int index = offset;
        int bound = 1000000;
        while (next != EOF && index < bound && next != ' ' && next != '\n') {
            data[index++] = (char) next;
            next = nextByte();
        }
        return index - offset;
    }

    bool hasMore() {
        skipBlank();
        return next != EOF;
    }
};

int main() {
    BlockReader input;
    if (getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") == NULL) {
        input = BlockReader("D:\\DataBase\\TESTCASE\\codeforces\\CF939F.in");
    } else {
        input = BlockReader();
    }

    int n = input.nextInteger();
    int k = input.nextInteger();

    int** intervals = new int*[k + 2];
    for (int i = 0; i <= k + 1; i++) {
        intervals[i] = new int[2];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        intervals[i][0] = input.nextInteger();
        intervals[i][1] = input.nextInteger();
    }
    intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
    intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;

    k++;

    Node* loop = new Node*[2];
    loop[0] = new Node();
    loop[1] = new Node();

    int* data = new int[n + 1];

    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        Node* curDp = loop[i & 1];

        Node* lastDp = loop[(i - 1) & 1];

        int intervalLength = intervals[i][1] - intervals[i][0];
        int middleLength = intervals[i][0] - intervals[i - 1][1];

        lastDp->toArray(0, n, data);
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            data[j] = min(data[j], j + 1);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            data[j] = min(data[j], j + 2);
        }
        lastDp->fromArray(0, n, data);

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int minNeedTime = lastDp->query(j - middleLength - intervalLength, j - middleLength, 0, n);
            data[j] = min(data[j], minNeedTime + 2);
        }

        curDp->fromArray(0, n, data);
    }

    int minFlipTime = loop[k & 1]->query(n, n, 0, n);

    if (minFlipTime < INF) {
        cout << "Full" << endl;
        cout << minFlipTime << endl;
    } else {
        cout << "Hungry" << endl;
    }

    delete[] intervals[0];
    for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
        delete[] intervals[i];
    }
    delete[] intervals;
    delete loop[0];
    delete loop[1];
    delete[] loop;
    delete[] data;

    return 0;
}
